To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the design and magnetic measurement of the first phase-II super bend dipole magnet have been finished successfully.
the design and measurement of a super-bend magnet for the SSRF beamline phase-II upgrade are presented.
a new field shimming method has been verified to be effective in the integral field shimming of a resistive dipole magnet with straight air slot in the poles.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and magnetic measurement of a superbend dipole magnet at SSRF.
the design, manufacturing and magnetic measurement of a 100 mm gap, 1000 mm long, 2.32 T super bend dipole for SSRF.
the design, manufacture, magnetic measurement, and field shimming of a superbend dipole magnet.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this is a good design for a resistive magnet with straight slots in the poles.
the magnetic design and measurement of the super bend magnet at SSRF have been completed successfully.
the design and magnetic measurement of the superbend dipole magnet at SSRF are successful.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a 2.32 T field has been achieved, with a field uniformity of 1.5 × 10−3 and a field integral uniformity of 2 × 10−4.

the field integral shims can be used to correct both the field integral distribution and the field integral gradient distribution, which is very useful in the design of magnets with air slots in the pole.
the design of the magnet is feasible, and the measured field is uniform enough for beam optics design.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the magnetic field uniformity of a magnet with an air slot can be controlled by the air slot width and depth.
a superbend magnet with a steering field of more than 2 T can be manufactured and measured with the current facilities and technologies at SSRF.
the air slot method is a simple and effective way to control the field integral uniformity of the magnets with a long length.
